newsitem.title: USA: FBI executes search warrants on JB Oxford.
newsitem.headline: FBI executes search warrants on JB Oxford.

text.p: The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) went to Beverly Hills-based discount broker JB Oxford Holdings Inc Tuesday and executed sealed federal search warrants, an FBI spokesman said.
Company officials declined to comment and the firm's legal counsel was not available.
FBI spokesman John Hoos said several agents went to the company early Tuesday morning. He said the warrants relate to a white collar crime investigation but declined to elaborate.
Shares of JB Oxford were halted on Nasdaq.

An outside spokeswoman for the company said it would be issuing a statement Tuesday. The FBI spokesman said agents were continuing their search at the firm and would likely remain there for most of the day.
Earlier this month, JB Oxford reported earnings of $0.01 per share or $105,000 on revenues of $18.2 million for the second quarter ended June 30, 1997.
The company this month also named a new chairman -- Felix Oeri,
chairman of Oeri Finance, JB Oxford's largest shareholder and head of international brokerage operations for JB Oxford in Basel Switzerland.
